en: Light NY update (08:45 CT / 14:54 UTC). The close's narrow box broke completely overnight and through Asia/London: in ETH the mapped sell (1,713.33 to 1,719.77) triggered (a sweep to 1,721.88 in Asia) and ran past tp1 (1,710.61) and tp2 (1,696.50); the support below (1,696.50 to 1,703.16) got invalidated when the overnight and Asia low reached 1,669.00, well under its stop (1,692.00). ETH now trades at 1,695.46.

In BTC both mapped zones also got invalidated: the bearish gap sell (61,374.04 to 61,405.52, stop 61,410.50) broke when the overnight high reached 61,682.01, and the golden pocket bounce (61,236.98 to 61,318.51, stop 61,196.00) broke when the overnight and Asia low fell to 59,390.86. BTC now trades at 60,473.54.

The net 24-hour move turned strongly bearish on both coins (ETH -5.05%, BTC -4.38%), the reverse of the close (ETH flat, BTC +0.75%). At the NY open (08:30 CT) the Nasdaq (NQ) also sold off hard from its open (26,888 to 26,369.50) on hawkish Fed comments (John Williams, higher rates 'over time') and fresh Iran sanctions announced by Scott Bessent: the close's divergence (Nasdaq up, crypto flat) is gone, both coins now go with the index selloff.

Two shock headlines landed in the last hour: the DOJ is moving to forfeit $1.1B in USDC from North Korea's old Binance hack (a legal action, not a new breach) and Russia accused Estonia of hostile actions. Neither is ETH or BTC specific, but both trigger the shock rule: a risk window through 15:40 UTC, max WAIT.

No live zone left on either coin: ETH's sell already played out and the other three zones broke on their stop. No GO: wait for new structure to form before the next entry. Conviction stays low on both (already at the floor).

Background risk steps up to MEDIUM: no new hack, but the shock window is active and overall DVOL rose to 67.16 (+3.72 on 24h), reversing the close's decline. Bitcoin ETF outflows, another $570 million (November total nearing $5 billion) right as BTC lost the $60K mark. Extreme fear holds unchanged (11).

counterCase.es: Si BTC cierra una vela de 15 minutos por encima de 61,405.52 (techo del hueco bajista y de la caja de hoy) sin volver, el rebote de las ultimas 24 horas tiene mas recorrido y el siguiente objetivo es el minimo del balance inicial (62,623.33 a 64,351.95); si en cambio rompe 61,041.54 (piso de la caja) el objetivo pasa a ser el valor de area bajo de ayer (60,647.96). El interes abierto de las dos monedas sigue bajando (ETH -1.82%, BTC -4.84% en 24 horas): el rebote se sostiene mas por cierre de posiciones que por compras nuevas, asi que perseguir la ruptura de cualquiera de los dos bordes sin retest es la fuga de siempre.
counterCase.en: If BTC closes a 15m candle above 61,405.52 (the bearish gap ceiling and today's box top) without coming back, the last 24 hours' bounce has more room and the next target is the initial-balance range low (62,623.33 to 64,351.95); if instead it breaks 61,041.54 (box floor) the target becomes yesterday's value-area low (60,647.96). Open interest keeps falling on both coins (ETH -1.82%, BTC -4.84% on 24h): the bounce is held up more by position closing than fresh buying, so chasing a break of either edge without a retest is the same old leak.

line.es: Ayer (23 nov) ETH y BTC rompieron con fuerza el techo mapeado sin volver (la venta A+ de las dos corridas quedo rota en las dos monedas) con interes abierto de ETH subiendo con fuerza; el sesgo automatico acerto en el close (+82.95 puntos ETH, +2,267.31 BTC) pero fallo en el ny cuando el shock de media tarde corto la extension (-63.71 ETH, -1,495.28 BTC). Predicciones de texto 0/8: los cuatro techos citados se rompieron en cierres de 15 minutos y los cuatro rangos tambien, primero por abajo de madrugada y despues por arriba por la tarde, mismo patron en las dos monedas. Zonas 2/8 tocadas-ganadoras: en el close las dos ventas A+ se rompieron sin reclamar y las dos compras B de continuacion fallaron al stop; en el ny las dos ventas A+ volvieron a romperse pero las dos compras B de continuacion si funcionaron esta vez (r 0.26 ETH, r 0.21 BTC).
line.en: Yesterday (Nov 23) ETH and BTC broke hard through the mapped ceiling without coming back (both runs' A+ sell stayed broken on both coins) with ETH open interest climbing hard; the automatic bias hit on the close (+82.95 points ETH, +2,267.31 BTC) but missed on the ny when the mid-afternoon shock cut the extension short (-63.71 ETH, -1,495.28 BTC). Text predictions 0/8: the four cited ceilings broke on 15-minute closes and the four ranges too, first to the downside overnight and then to the upside in the afternoon, same pattern on both coins. Zones 2/8 touched-and-won: on the close both A+ sells broke without reclaiming and both B continuation buys stopped out; on the ny both A+ sells broke again but both B continuation buys did work this time (r 0.26 ETH, r 0.21 BTC).

updated.es: La noche y la sesion de Asia/Londres rompieron toda la estructura angosta del close: en ETH la venta mapeada disparo y corrio mas alla de sus dos objetivos (gatillo consumido), mientras el soporte de abajo quedo roto por su stop; en BTC las dos zonas (venta y rebote) quedaron invalidadas por su stop cuando el precio hizo un barrido mucho mas amplio de lo mapeado. El movimiento neto de 24 horas se volvio bajista fuerte en las dos monedas (ETH -5.05%, BTC -4.38%), al reves de lo que tenia el close (ETH plano, BTC +0.75%). En la apertura de NY (08:30 CT) el Nasdaq cayo con fuerza por comentarios halconES de la Fed (John Williams) y nuevas sanciones a Iran anunciadas por Bessent: la divergencia del close (Nasdaq arriba, cripto plano) desaparecio, ahora las dos monedas acompañan la caida del indice. Dos titulares de shock en la ultima hora (decomiso del DOJ sobre el hackeo viejo de Binance de Corea del Norte, Rusia acusando a Estonia) ponen una ventana de riesgo hasta las 15:40 UTC, maximo WAIT mientras dure. Conviccion se queda baja en las dos monedas (ya estaba en el piso); sin zona viva en ninguna de las dos, el plan es esperar que se forme estructura nueva antes de buscar una entrada.
updated.en: Overnight and the Asia/London session broke all of the close's narrow structure: in ETH the mapped sell triggered and ran past both targets (trigger spent), while the support below broke on its stop; in BTC both zones (sell and bounce) got invalidated on their stop when price made a much wider sweep than mapped. The net 24-hour move turned strongly bearish on both coins (ETH -5.05%, BTC -4.38%), the reverse of the close (ETH flat, BTC +0.75%). At the NY open (08:30 CT) the Nasdaq sold off hard on hawkish Fed comments (John Williams) and fresh Iran sanctions announced by Bessent: the close's divergence (Nasdaq up, crypto flat) is gone, both coins now go with the index selloff. Two shock headlines in the last hour (the DOJ's forfeiture action on North Korea's old Binance hack, Russia accusing Estonia) set a risk window through 15:40 UTC, max WAIT while it lasts. Conviction stays low on both coins (already at the floor); with no live zone on either, the plan is to wait for new structure to form before looking for an entry.
